pins.label: Bank job, lake road
pins.hint: Reported: on the road that runs south from the big lake toward the city.

pins.label: Bank job, north suburbs
pins.hint: Reported: in the suburbs on the northern edge of the city.

pins.label: Bank job, inland suburbs
pins.hint: Reported: inland, north of the airfield, where the east to west road crosses.

pins.label: Bank job, west coast
pins.hint: Reported: the only one on the west coast, near the inlet.

pins.label: Bank job, beach strip 1
pins.hint: Reported: north end of the long beach strip.

pins.label: Bank job, beach strip 2
pins.hint: Reported: on the beach strip, a little south of the first.

pins.label: Bank job, beach strip 3
pins.hint: Reported: middle of the beach strip.

pins.label: Bank job, lagoon shore
pins.hint: Reported: on the city shore, facing the beach strip across the lagoon.

pins.label: Bank job, beach strip 4
pins.hint: Reported: toward the south end of the beach strip.

pins.label: Bank job, city centre 1
pins.hint: Reported: in the dense middle of the city, north-east of the airfield.

pins.label: Bank job, city centre 2
pins.hint: Reported: a block or two east of the first city-centre job.

pins.label: Bank job, airfield road

pins.label: Bank job, south city 1

pins.label: Bank job, the spit

pins.label: Top of the tallest mast

pins.label: Something on a night road

pins.label: The thing that beeps
pins.hint: Approximate area: the canyon country in the northern hills. Unsolved so far.

storyLines.label: Opening: bank your cash often
storyLines.tip: Cash you carry is lost when you die. Money in the bank is safer.

storyLines.label: Opening: scan a car before you steal it
storyLines.tip: The scanner shows alarms and trackers.

storyLines.label: Opening: learn which doors open
storyLines.tip: Dark-blue buildings on the map can be entered and the minimap marks the door. In focus view, white doors are open to you and red ones are alarmed.

storyLines.label: Opening: avoid needless killing
storyLines.tip: Guides agree the worst level of your criminal profile is permanent.

storyLines.label: Opening: sleep to move the clock
storyLines.tip: Some shops and jobs only run at certain hours.

storyLines.label: Chapter 1: open the bank account
storyLines.tip: It comes with an early job, an hour or two in. Until then, cash can be hidden under the bedroom floor at the first house.

storyLines.label: Chapter 1: do the neighbour's two errands
storyLines.tip: Both close when the chapter's ending starts, and skipping the first removes the second.

storyLines.label: Chapter 1: meditate with your partner at the first house
storyLines.tip: The spot closes with the chapter. Guides disagree on whether the trophy needs it, so take it.

storyLines.label: Chapter 1: finish the side content around the first town
storyLines.tip: Reported: after the chapter free roam is limited for a few hours and the area is a long drive back.

storyLines.label: Money, chapter 1: move cash into savings before the ending
storyLines.tip: Savings deposits cannot be lost; cash in your pocket goes in the ending. Two guides suggest about 5,000. Guides disagree on how much other money survives.

storyLines.label: Money, chapter 1: do not grind, and do not upgrade the first pickup
storyLines.tip: Reported: early earning is slow, registers pay a few hundred at most, and the pickup is lost later.

storyLines.label: Chapter 1: make a separate save before the package pickup at the visitor centre
storyLines.tip: That job starts a three-job ending with no way back, and the first house is gone afterwards.

storyLines.label: Chapter 2: try switching leads and the partner activities
storyLines.tip: Both open with a mid-chapter job. Reported: there is no map warp, so switching is the cheapest way across the map.

storyLines.label: Money, chapter 2: sell clean stolen cars to the garage contact
storyLines.tip: Opens with his job. Only cars without a tracker. Reported: about 1,000 a car, a two-minute wait between sales, and not cars taken near his garage.

storyLines.label: Money, chapter 2: build up the savings tiers
storyLines.tip: Deposits are permanent. Reported tiers: 5,000, 10,000 and 100,000 saved lift the spending account's limit to 15,000, 100,000 and 500,000, with discounts on rides and garages.

storyLines.label: Chapter 2: buy a garage once the story allows it
storyLines.tip: Reported: a story job unlocks buying garages. One guide's first buys are a suppressor, then a garage.

storyLines.label: Chapter 2: pawn-shop smash-and-grabs open
storyLines.tip: Reported: they open with the same mid-chapter job as switching.

storyLines.label: Chapter 2: have 15,000 ready for the last job
storyLines.tip: Reported: the chapter's closing job needs at least 15,000. Make a separate save before it.

storyLines.label: Chapter 3: start loan stores and small banks after the jammer job
storyLines.tip: A story job gives a tool that stops dye packs. Before it the cash is ruined.

storyLines.label: Money, chapter 3: jewellery stores
storyLines.tip: Open mid-chapter with a new lock tool. Reported: 10,000 to 25,000 a store, and they can be done back to back.

storyLines.label: Money, chapter 3: the high-end car wish list
storyLines.tip: Opens with the key-cloning tool. Guides give 30,000 to 35,000 a car delivered in perfect condition, and disagree on whether the list is 16 or 18 cars.

storyLines.label: Money, chapter 3: tracked cars can be sold at the respray shop
storyLines.tip: Reported: about 4,000 a car. Guides disagree on when this opens: early chapter 3 or chapter 4.

storyLines.label: Money, chapter 3: pick the right fence
storyLines.tip: Fences pay different rates. Two guides agree one fence pays best for jewellery and marked bills and another for narcotics, so try each.

storyLines.label: Chapter 3: take the optional street race when it appears
storyLines.tip: It is timed and can be missed. Reported: a second optional pickup job can be missed too.

storyLines.label: Chapter 4: take the optional wait at the café
storyLines.tip: Late in the chapter it opens large vaults and armoured vans. Guides give up to about 200,000 a vault and an instant four-star response. Reported: a fence sells van tips for 10,000.

storyLines.label: Money, chapter 4: the side series with a coin to buy
storyLines.tip: Reported: it lets you buy a coin that climbs sharply. Sell before the series ends.

storyLines.label: Chapter 4: take the optional timed phone job
storyLines.tip: Reported: it can be missed.

storyLines.label: Chapter 4: finish each lead's own side stories before the last job
storyLines.tip: Reported: do them before the chapter's final job.

storyLines.label: Chapter 4: make a separate save before the last job
storyLines.tip: Reported: it is a point of no return. Save again before the finale.

storyLines.label: Chapter 5: the short final chapter
storyLines.tip: Guides list seven to nine jobs. There is no mission replay. Reported: after the credits you are put back just before the finale.

storyLines.label: After the story: open the 100% list
storyLines.tip: It appears on the stats page after the credits, and earlier progress already counts.

storyLines.label: After the story: the money code
storyLines.tip: Reported: a 250,000 money code unlocks. Using it stops trophy progress for that session.
